blocks.text: An indoor-outdoor sofa set featuring a durable sofa frame, water-repellent fabric covers, and a high-strength iron frame for long-lasting use. Backed by a 3-year warranty from our after-sales team, ensuring reliable quality.

items: OUTDOOR SOFA SET - The 7-piece outdoor sectional sofa features a sturdy steel frame that will never rust. Wicker is strong enough to withstand all weather changes. Thick waterproof durable cushions and tempered glass are easy to clean. Enjoy your great afternoon!

WHAT'S INCLUDED - This outdoor patio sofa set comes with 2 boxes, including 4 single sofas, 2 corner sofas, 1 coffee table with a tempered glass top, cushions and seat fastener clips. We have different colors of rattan and cushions available.

WATER RESISTANT & ANTI-SLIP DESIGN - The 7 pieces outdoor patio conversation set is water resistant design, including rattan and cushions and backrest. The bottom comes with non-slip design, which can prevent sliding and give you a better experience.

EASY CLEANING AND ASSEMBLY - Wicker rattan furniture Comes complete with clear instructions and installation tools, with each part individually numbered and illustrated. Removable cushions are easy to replace and clean.

VERSATILE AND STUNNING - Prepare to be the envy of every gathering. Our wicker patio furniture allows you to effortlessly customize your seating arrangement, adapting to any occasion, whether it's a backyard party, garden retreat, or poolside oasis. (Please note: Due to the nature of our shipping process, your packages may arrive separately. If you encounter any issues, our dedicated customer service team is here to assist you.)
